segments.oily: A reviewer with historically oily, cystic-acne-prone skin reports the peel is gentle enough for daily use once skin is acclimated to acids, leaving it softer, brighter and more hydrated while lightening dark spots.
segments.dry: A reviewer with dry, sensitive skin reports the 15% acid blend does not irritate her despite the strength, using it on both face and body.
segments.sensitive: Most sensitive-skin reviewers report no redness, stinging or dryness even with regular use, describing it as one of the gentlest peels they have tried.
segments.normal: One reviewer who says she does not have sensitive or acne-prone skin reports the product felt too tingly for her liking and caused a breakout the next day.

concerns.aging: One reviewer reports the wrinkle creases on her wrists disappeared after about a week of nightly use on her body; another credits the glycolic acid concentration with supporting anti-aging and collagen production for her skin.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, even those with dry or sensitive skin, report the peel leaves skin feeling soft and hydrated rather than stripped; one reviewer notes that increasing usage too quickly led to noticeable dryness.
concerns.redness: A brief tingling or mild burning sensation on application is commonly described as normal and fading within seconds to about ten minutes; most reviewers report no lasting redness, though one reviewer without sensitive or acne-prone skin found the tingling too strong for her liking.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report dark spots, sun spots or hyperpigmentation fading or lightening with regular use over one to several weeks.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer without acne-prone skin reports breaking out the day after her first use; another with a history of cystic acne reports the peel gently brings clogged pores and comedones to the surface without worsening her acne.

aspects.libelle: Milky, lightweight texture that spreads easily
Brief tingling or stinging on application that fades quickly
Large bottle, generous amount for the price
Sometimes arrives previously opened, missing a seal
Doubles as a body treatment for crepey skin and sun damage

extraits.texte: I used this and it made me break out. I read so many of the reviews that said it was good and just had to try it. I have used their other products such as the Half and Half, hand cream, and other items, and love those. This product though, made my face very "tingly", too tingly for my liking. Then the next day I woke up to a break out. I don't have sensitive skin and I don't have acne prone skin. So this is a no for me. I don't recommend and no I wouldn't repurchase.

This is a strong exfoliating peel, and it definitely works. The milk texture spreads easily and feels controlled, but you can tell right away that this is not a beginner exfoliant. At 15% glycolic acid, it delivers noticeable smoothing and brightness when used carefully. I started slowly and kept my routine very simple afterward, focusing on hydration and barrier support. Used this way, it helped refine texture and made my skin look clearer and more even. When I increased usage too quickly, I noticed dryness, which was a good reminder that this peel needs to be respected. I would recommend this to experienced skincare users who are comfortable with chemical exfoliation and understand the importance of spacing treatments and supporting the skin barrier. It’s effective, but not something to rush or overuse. I used less than the recommended amount and it was still a little spicy for me.

I have historically had oily skin with really stubborn cystic acne. The acne has calmed down over the years but it's still an issue along with clogged pores, enlarged pores, rough and patchy skin, blackheads, hyperpigmentation and milia. I've always used products with various acids to help with cell turnover along with physical exfoliants to remove dead skin but you have to be careful with these kinds of products because overuse can cause irritation and dry skin and exacerbate existing problems. Prequel is the perfect balance of very gentle but also very effective exfoliation. It leaves my skin softer and brighter and somehow also adds a ton of hydration. Since my skin is used to acids, I'm able to use Prequel every day. I apply it to a round, flat cotton pad and rub it all over my face and neck. I go over certain problem areas and second time. I let it dry and then apply any additional serums and treatments. I was able to notice a difference after the first use. My pores were smaller and my skin just looked brighter. With consistent use, it's gently brought comedones and clogged pores to the surface and lightened dark spots. It also worked wonders for my lips. THIS IS IT. This needs to be a permanent beauty staple item in your toolkit! I use Dennis Gross acid wipes for my face, it has erased my melasma with maintenance of course but this stuff is THE item for your body and crepey skin. Dennis Gross wipes are too expensive and small to use over your whole body. Amlactin is amazing but it does have that signature lactic acid smell and sometimes I don’t want lotion on me. I had never heard of Prequel before this. It was cheap enough and had all the acids I was looking for. I’ve only been using it for one week and it definitely has all the lactic acid magic in it! The wrinkle bend creases on my wrists are gone. My sun damage freckles and spots are fading. It’s so fast and easy to use. It dries fast. I put it on my arms and legs every single night while watching my bedtime TV routine. I’m here to buy a second bottle. I’m not a bot! Ladies we need this. I’ll update some photos later on. I’m sad I didn’t take a before photo. Also, remember any lactic acid products you MUST wear sunscreen after/during treatment. It makes you more prone to burn. I haven’t used this on my chest area sun damage but I have used PTR acid products there and it works phenomenally. Sometimes it pills so I may switch to this for my chest.

The best. This contains a blend of 15% aha acids. 15% can be strong but I think bc of the formula it’s actually gentle. My skin is dry and sensitive and this doesn’t irritate me. I use on the face and body. For the face I do once a week. For the body I use three times and my body feels great. Glycolic acid at that percentage does help with anti aging for this skin and collagen production.

I have been enjoying this peel. My skin does well with manual exfoliation and needs it like microdermabrasion and microneedling. I have been trying to cut down on costs and thought I should start chemical exfoliation. I recently tried the Dr. Dennis Peel Pad. I only used it once and didn't notice anything different in one use (I'm sure that's not a fair rating) BUT with one use of the prequel milky peel, I did experience the post glow effect and my skin didn't feel dry. I was able to use it every night for three days with no negative effects. With that alone, it made my pores appear smaller and lightened two dark spots. I am continuing to use it every other night :) This is also my first prequel product so I am excited to try more in the future.

I’m really impressed with this peel. It gives you that smooth, fresh-skin feeling without any burning or irritation. The texture is milky and lightweight, and it spreads easily so you don’t need much. I love that it uses a blend of gentle acids my skin looks brighter and more even the next morning. I have sensitive skin and this didn’t cause redness or dryness at all. It’s perfect for those times when you want a quick exfoliation but nothing harsh. Overall it’s become one of my go-to products for keeping my skin looking clear and glowy.
